description: The Reticle Harness is { action: "explore" }: when the user asks for the Harness, or asks Reticle to drive and verify the app for you, call it and do not drive… e.g. {"action":"change","files":["src/App.tsx"]}

app.description: Also fold into the app-wide ledger; returns `app.levels`.

confirmDangerous.description: Set true to allow destructive controls during this run of the suite only.

driveId.description: The drive id an explore call answered with.

exhaustive.description: Walk every state it can tell apart, drive each write's failure path, fold into the coverage ledger.

expect.description: Predicate it must end in (route, net, state), asserted after.

flowName.description: Flow file name (without .json), from reticle_verify { action: "flows" }, which names every saved flow.

labels.description: Verify flows with ANY of these labels.

maxSteps.description: Maximum number of controls to click.

parallel.description: Replay this many affected flows at once (needs the browser pool).

persona.description: The journey in plain words; "quoted text" must show at the end.

planId.description: Run a plan saved on the dashboard, as it stands.

runId.description: The run id an explore call answered with; pass it to poll that run.

say.description: With runId: a note to the running Harness.

scope.description: CSS selector or element ref to restrict crawling to a subtree.

secrets.description: Redacted fields' values, this call only, never kept: { "auth-password": "…" }

sessionId.description: Target a specific tab. Omit unless you mean one — see instructions.

settleMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after each click for the app to react.

skipWrites.description: Certify without changing data: hold back every flow with a step that sends a write request (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), and name them in `skippedWrites`.

stop.description: With runId: stop that Harness run.

name: reticle_verify
